content: ...</p> <h2><strong>Your Mission</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Planning:</strong> Establish, align, and execute comprehensive 5-year joint business plans with critical distributor partners across key regional markets, bridging long-term strategic vision with daily execution.</li> <li><strong>Pricing Strategy &amp; Governance:</strong> Formulate and manage the regional pricing strategy for footwear, apparel, and accessories across diverse distributor markets, ensuring brand equity is protected while optimizing local competitiveness and margin targets.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Negotiations:</strong> Lead commercial terms and contract negotiations with regional distributors. Establish clear, value-based discount structures, incentive programs, and commercial policies that drive mutual growth.</li> <li><strong>Omnichannel Governance:</strong> Direct and optimize inventory management across all distributor-led channels—including wholesale distribution networks, localized e-commerce platforms, and distributor-owned mono-brand retail stores.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Execution:</strong> Partner with distributors to manage daily account operations, including robust order book management, sell-in and sell-out tracking, and optimizing product assortment to ensure healthy inventory rotations.</li> <li><strong>Strategy Implementation:</strong> Support the Distributor Director in deploying the overarching LATAM &amp; CAC commercial strategy, ensuring a premium, consistent, and structured brand presence in all distributor-led territories.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Planning:</strong> Drive category-level forecasting and bottom-up distribution planning across footwear, apparel, and accessories, aligning with product launch timelines and regional demand.</li> <li><strong>Market Intelligence:</strong> Conduct regular market, competitor, and distributor performance analyses to identify white-space opportunities, evaluate commerci

... updates, performance parameters, and costing details to leadership.</li> <li>Communication &amp; Cultural Fluency: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, Asia production partners, and multi-disciplinary R&amp;D units.</li> <li>Travel: Willingness to travel internationally up to 15% of the time for factory reviews, supplier collaboration, and prototype builds.</li> </ul> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>About the Team </strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>On’s Innovation team is responsible for On’s future innovation, out-of-the-box thinking and the outstanding athlete-informed technology that differentiates On footwear from all other footwear products in the market. If you are interested in being a part of an agile and interdisciplinary team of experts in the area of engineering and sports sciences, come join us!</div>
